title: Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.2
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.2 is an experimental snapshot build with early Motif-3 NVFP4 support on the Dynamo vLLM backend. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.5.0-motif-3-dev.2 serves Motif-Technologies/Motif-3-NVFP4 on Dynamo vLLM. The amd64 CUDA 13.0 runtime is built on Motif's vLLM v0.26.0-motif3 base, with vLLM-Omni disabled, and installs NIXL v1.3.2. The image bakes in Motif NIXL compatibility fixes: KV-cache rank follows the attention backend's MLA flag (rank 3 for MLA, rank 4 otherwise), and Motif keeps its NHD cache layout (#16291).
Kubernetes recipes cover aggregated serving on two B200 GPUs and disaggregated 3P1D serving on eight B200 GPUs: three TP2 prefill workers and one TP2 decode worker, with KV-aware routing and NIXL transfer. Both profiles use expert parallelism, MTP2, an FP8 KV cache, a 262,144-token context, prefix caching, and a shared model cache. The 3P1D recipe from #16314 is on this branch in #16392 (recipe folder).

About Motif-3
Motif-3 NVFP4 is Motif Technologies' preview checkpoint published on Hugging Face as Motif-Technologies/Motif-3-NVFP4. This build serves it through Dynamo's vLLM backend as either an aggregated two-GPU B200 deployment or an eight-GPU 3P1D deployment with KV-aware routing.
Full Changelog
vLLM Backend
Motif NIXL compatibility: The runtime image patches the pinned Motif vLLM source during the build so workers can transfer KV cache without a writable source tree. Cache-rank checks use the attention backend's MLA flag, and Motif retains the NHD layout (#16291).
Recipes
Motif-3 NVFP4 recipes: recipes/motif-3 includes a shared model-cache PVC and Hugging Face download Job, an aggregated B200 chat profile, and a disaggregated 3P1D profile with KV-aware routing and NIXL transfer. Both default to real MTP2 verification. An optional synthetic acceptance length of 2.13 is available for benchmarking, including a concurrency-64 disaggregated run with a 32-request warmup (recipe folder, README, #16392, #16314).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps — namespace, hf-token-secret, model-cache PVC, download Job, aggregated or 3P1D apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test — are in the recipe README and the Fern guide. The download Job is the only step that needs the Hugging Face token. For 3P1D, each TP2 worker occupies two GPUs on one node, and the fabric must allow NIXL/UCX transfer between nodes. Optional Nscale scheduling is a Kustomize component on the generic manifest.
Known Issues / Limitations
Experimental snapshot build — not QA-gated; not for production.
The vLLM runtime image is amd64 only, and recipes reference it by tag rather than digest.
The runtime image carries Motif-specific vLLM compatibility code. Do not replace its vLLM package with an unrelated wheel.
Disaggregated serving is validated for TP2 on both prefill and decode. Other tensor-parallel sizes are unvalidated.
Shipped manifests use real MTP verification. Results measured with synthetic acceptance length 2.13 are a benchmark-only proxy and are not reproduced by the manifests as shipped.
In the reference aggregated chat trace, 35 requests exceed the 262,144-token context limit.
